description: Forget a remembered object by key. `mode` defaults to "revert": on a chain head created with `supersedes` it tombstones the head and restores the predecessor; otherwise it tombstones the target. "chain" tombstones every version of the chain. "object" tombstones only this object. On a synced chunk `mode` is ignored: the whole source is forgotten and never re-ingested (`sync_source_id` names it).

key.description: The key to forget, as returned by `remember`.

name: forget
title: Delete a memory
